I’ve been in the neighborhood long enough to recognize a truly exceptional pet store when I see one—and TAMS Pet Food & Supplies takes that distinction every single time. Nestled at 19305 Vanowen Street, this family-owned gem has quietly become my go-to for everything fur-friendly.

What keeps me coming back isn’t just the vast selection—from classic favorites to those intriguing international brands—but the remarkable knowledge and genuine helpfulness of the owner and staff. They’re quick to help you find exactly what you need, and they know their products inside and out.

They also have a neat extra: a low-cost mobile vet that pops in regularly—perfect for when you need advice, services, or just that peace of mind. It’s clear this place is run by people who genuinely care about animals and the people who love them.

Bottom line? If you’re after thoughtful guidance, exceptional product variety, and a pet-lover’s touch that feels like your favorite local haunt, TAMS is worth its weight in treats (and then some). Five stars, no question.

This place is a staple in the Valley for pet owners. It has everything you could need, from quality food to toys and supplies. The owners are a delight, knowledgeable, friendly, and always willing to help you find exactly what you’re looking for. A truly dependable neighborhood shop that cares about your pets as much as you do.

Tams is the only one who carry the cat food that our Tortie is obsessed with. But moreover, the people who run this small business are some of the friendliest in the Valley. They have so many different options to choose from - litter, wet food and dry food & toys and all the accessories. Competitively priced, too. If you're ever lost, walk up to the counter and they will happily assist you and provide you with ample knowledge on what's best for your animal based on your animal's needs. You won't find this customer service at big name stores run by teenagers making min wage. They also have a mobile vet that comes by I believe once a month for non-aesthetic dental cleanings for cats & dogs that every owner should take advantage of since oral health is often overlooked for animals but its super impt for their overall health (just like humans!). They also offer low cost vaccinations, and other services. Lots of parking here.

p.s. if you're a sucker like me you can even stop by the See's candies next door on the way out for some samples and a box of chocolates.... you nvr know what you'll get ;)

I came to buy a Cardboard Pet Carrier for our cat. The young lady assembled one for me. The next day we used the carrier to take our cat to the vet for his routine hydration treatment and while we were walking from the parking lot to the vet's clinic the bottom part of the carrier opened up and our cat was spilled out on the ground, confused and scared. Thank goodness I was able to pick him up right away. We asked for a tape at the vet's clinic so we can tape the bottom part of the box, and being careful bringing our cat back to the car to take him home by holding the bottom part of the box. Right that same day, we returned the box to the store, I told the older lady what happened and the first thing she can say is that "well, the box is not properly assembled". I told her that their sales person assembled it for me. Then she told us that there were already some returns of the box carrier due to the same incident we had. So I told her that they better stop selling that particular carrier to avoid a very bad experience to happen to others. I told her that I am still shaking due to what happened that we almost lost our cat because of their bad merchandise, and I don't want other pet owners experience what we've experienced because theirs might end up in a very tragic way. Then she proceeded to tell us her experience with another carrier they have that also opened and bunch of kittens spilled out from the carrier. My concern is number 1. The merchandise is dangerous to sell because it's poorly made . And number 2. This older lady have no empathy at all to our experience. All she can say right away is that the box is not assembled properly. Not even a little sympathy regarding our experience which could have been really bad if I wasn't able to pick up our cat right away. Then she tells us a story to top our experience????
What a cold person to be working in a store that's supposed to take care of innocent animals.

Btw, this happened a while back but wanted to share this unpleasant experience.
